forest-depths.$description: Forest Depths — Primary brand color — filled CTAs, dark section backgrounds, navigation surfaces, and primary body text. A near-black green that reads as ink on snow-white and as depth in dark sections

lime-pulse.$description: Lime Pulse — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content.

sage-moss.$description: Sage Moss — Product variant accent — DM-02 Daily Multivitamin card and supporting elements. Muted green that harmonizes with Forest Depths without competing

olive-gold.$description: Olive Gold — Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content.

eucalyptus.$description: Eucalyptus — Product variant accent — PM-02 Sleep + Restore card and supporting elements. Cooler green-blue for the evening product

snow-white.$description: Snow White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text, and primary inverse text. A warm off-white (not pure white) that softens the high-contrast dark green and reads organic rather than clinical-sterile

warm-stone.$description: Warm Stone — Secondary surface — alternating section backgrounds, subtle panels, and muted separators. Sits between Snow White and the dark sections to create quiet rhythm

frosted-glass.$description: Frosted Glass — Translucent surface and frosted-glass overlay backgrounds (used with backdrop-filter: blur). Also serves as a muted neutral surface for content cards on white sections

ash.$description: Ash — Disabled button backgrounds, muted button states, and low-emphasis borders

pewter.$description: Pewter — Secondary body text, captions, and low-emphasis helper text. Provides one tier of text de-emphasis below primary Forest Depths

ink.$description: Ink — Primary body text on light sections where maximum contrast is needed. Used sparingly — most text defaults to Forest Depths for tonal warmth

seed-sans.$description: Primary brand typeface — used for all UI, headings, body, navigation, and buttons. Weights 300–350 at display sizes (40–48px) is the signature choice: whisper-light headlines convey scientific confidence through restraint, not volume. Most CPG brands shout with 700-weight headlines; Seed whispers with 300.

seed-sans-mono.$description: Monospaced companion for product codes (DS-01®, DM-02™), ingredient lists, and data/specs. The slight positive letter-spacing (+0.015em) creates a measured, clinical tone.
